title: [ingest] Journal cosine bands are fixed at six buckets
summary: The verdict journal bins similarity into six half-open bands: `[0.25,0.30)`, `[0.30,0.35)`, `[0.35,0.40)`, `[0.40,0.45)`, `[0.45,0.50)`, and `[0.50,∞)`. That gives `keepRateByBand` a fixed calibration grid rather than a dynamic partition.
